contact.question: What services does Creo Media offer?
contact.answer: Creo Media specializes in Content Production, Digital Management, Event Management, and Podcasting. We create premium creative solutions tailored to your brand's needs.

contact.question: How long does a typical project take?
contact.answer: Project timelines vary based on scope and complexity. Simple content pieces may take 1-2 weeks, while comprehensive campaigns can range from 4-12 weeks. We'll provide a detailed timeline during the consultation phase.

contact.question: What's your pricing model?
contact.answer: We offer flexible pricing options: project-based, retainer packages, or hourly rates depending on your needs. We'll provide a custom quote after discussing your requirements and goals.

contact.question: Do you work with startups and small businesses?
contact.answer: Absolutely! We work with businesses of all sizes, from startups to established corporations. We scale our services to match your budget and needs.

contact.question: Can you handle rush projects?
contact.answer: Yes, we can accommodate urgent timelines. Rush projects may have additional fees depending on team availability and scope. Contact us to discuss your specific timeline.

contact.question: Do you provide revisions?
contact.answer: Yes! Revision rounds are included in our packages. The number of revisions varies by project type. We ensure you're satisfied with the final deliverables.

contact.question: How do we communicate during the project?
contact.answer: We maintain regular communication through email, video calls, and project management tools. You'll have a dedicated point of contact for your project.

contact.question: What's your process for content creation?
contact.answer: Our process includes: Discovery & Strategy, Concept Development, Production/Creation, Review & Feedback, Revisions, and Final Delivery. We keep you involved at every stage.

contact.question: Do you offer maintenance and support after project completion?
contact.answer: Yes! We offer ongoing support packages for content updates, platform maintenance, analytics reporting, and strategic guidance.

contact.question: Can you help with distribution and promotion?
contact.answer: We provide guidance on distribution strategies and can manage social media posting, email campaigns, and other promotion channels as part of our Digital Management services.

contact.question: What's your process for client onboarding?
contact.answer: We start with an initial consultation to understand your goals, brand, and needs. We'll then create a proposal, sign an agreement, and begin the project planning phase.

contact.question: How do I book a consultation?
contact.answer: You can book directly through our website contact form, or reach out to us at contact.creomedia@gmail.com. We'll get back to you within 24 hours.

about.question: Who is Creo Media?
about.answer: Creo Media is a premium creative agency based in Windhoek, Namibia. We specialize in creating innovative content and digital solutions that help brands stand out.

about.question: What's your company mission?
about.answer: Our mission is to deliver exceptional creative solutions that empower brands and drive meaningful results. We believe in the power of African creativity combined with global standards.

about.question: How long has Creo Media been in business?
about.answer: We've been delivering premium creative services for several years, building a strong reputation for quality, innovation, and client satisfaction.

about.question: Where is Creo Media located?
about.answer: We're based in Windhoek, Namibia, but we work with clients locally and internationally.

about.question: What makes Creo Media different?
about.answer: We combine African creativity with global standards. Our team brings diverse expertise, attention to detail, and a passion for delivering exceptional results.

about.question: Who is on the Creo Media team?
about.answer: Our team consists of experienced content creators, digital strategists, designers, videographers, and project managers, all dedicated to delivering excellence.

about.question: What industries do you specialize in?
about.answer: We work across diverse industries including tech, retail, hospitality, nonprofits, healthcare, and more. Our experience spans various sectors and markets.

about.question: Can you handle international projects?
about.answer: Yes! We work with clients across Africa and beyond. We understand different markets and can adapt our approach to various audiences and cultures.

portfolio.question: How do you select case studies to showcase?
portfolio.answer: We showcase projects that demonstrate our capabilities, represent different service areas, and highlight measurable results and client success.

portfolio.question: Can you work in my industry?
portfolio.answer: Likely yes! We've worked across various industries. Even if we haven't worked in your specific sector, our diverse experience allows us to deliver quality work.

portfolio.question: How do you measure project success?
portfolio.answer: We measure success through agreed-upon KPIs: engagement rates, traffic, conversions, brand awareness, customer satisfaction, and project-specific metrics.

portfolio.question: Can we see more examples?
portfolio.answer: Absolutely! Contact us and we can share a portfolio tailored to your industry and project type. We may have additional case studies not publicly displayed.

portfolio.question: Do you have client testimonials?
portfolio.answer: Yes! We have testimonials from satisfied clients. You can find them throughout our website, and we can connect you with references upon request.

portfolio.question: What's your approach to confidential projects?
portfolio.answer: We respect client confidentiality. Some projects aren't publicly showcased due to client requests. We can discuss these experiences under NDA.

services.question: How does Content Production differ from Digital Management?
services.answer: Content Production focuses on creating high-quality videos, photos, and creative assets. Digital Management handles strategy, social media, and online presence optimization.

services.question: Can I use Creo Media for a one-time project?
services.answer: Yes! We offer both project-based and retainer services. You can hire us for a single project or develop an ongoing partnership.

services.question: Do you provide strategy consulting?
services.answer: Yes, strategy is integrated into most of our services. We can also provide standalone strategy consulting for content, digital, or event initiatives.

services.question: What equipment do you use?
services.answer: We use professional-grade equipment for content production including 4K cameras, drones, professional audio equipment, and state-of-the-art editing software.

services.question: Do you provide training and support?
services.answer: Yes! We can train your team on content creation, social media management, and other skills. We also provide ongoing support for all our services.

services.question: What's included in ongoing support?
services.answer: Ongoing support can include content updates, platform maintenance, analytics reporting, strategy refinement, and performance optimization based on your needs.

services.question: Can you work with my existing tools and platforms?
services.answer: Yes! We're skilled with various platforms, tools, and software. We'll integrate our work with your existing systems and workflows.
